tools.name: janam_kundali
tools.description: Vedic birth chart (Janam Kundali) by Trikaal Vaani: Lagna (ascendant), Moon sign (Rashi), Nakshatra and pada, all 9 grahas with sign, house, nakshatra, retrograde and dignity, and the running Mahadasha/Antardasha. Swiss Ephemeris, Lahiri ayanamsa.

tools.name: dasha_timeline
tools.description: Current Vimshottari Mahadasha and Antardasha with exact dates, all Antardashas of the running Mahadasha, and the full Mahadasha sequence (BPHS Ch.46-49). Trikaal Vaani, Swiss Ephemeris.

tools.name: planet_strength
tools.description: Shadbala strength of the 7 grahas (BPHS Ch.27): ratio against the classical minimum, strongest and weakest planet. Trikaal Vaani shows the real number, not just a label.

tools.name: yog_check
tools.description: Classical yoga strength from the birth chart with the reason behind every point, plus the granth summary (saar): government job / UPSC / IAS, foreign settlement, foreign spouse / NRI marriage, marriage timing (shadi kab hogi), children (santan), second marriage, love or arranged marriage. Free view;

tools.name: dosha_check
tools.description: Checks Kaal Sarp, Pitra, Guru Chandal, Grahan and Mangal (Manglik) dosha, with Manglik house details and cancellation conditions. Trikaal Vaani, Swiss Ephemeris.

tools.name: sade_sati
tools.description: Whether Saturn Sade Sati is running for this Moon sign, the current cycle dates and all cycles in life. Trikaal Vaani.

tools.name: muhurat_karma_list
tools.description: List of the 40 works (karma ids) for which a personal Shubh Muhurat can be calculated — marriage, engagement, griha pravesh, vehicle purchase, business start, exam form and more.

tools.name: shubh_muhurat
tools.description: Auspicious dates AND times for a chosen work, personalised to the birth chart (Brihat Samhita rules). Free view covers the next 3 months.

tools.name: child_birth_muhurat
tools.description: Best delivery / C-section time inside the doctor-approved window on a given date. Free view: best slot in the first hour of the window with Lagna, Nakshatra and quality label; the full-window best slot is in the paid report. Never suggests a time outside the doctor window.

tools.name: kundali_milan
tools.description: Ashtakoot Guna Milan (36 points) for a bride and groom with koota-wise scores and dosha checks. Free view; detailed compatibility report with remedies is on Trikaal Vaani.

tools.name: gemstone_check
tools.description: Scores all 9 gemstones 0-100 for this exact chart (functional benefic, Shadbala, dignity, afflictions) with a should-you-wear verdict and reason, plus the lagna-lord life stone. Covers Neelam, Pukhraj, Panna, Manik, Moti, Moonga, Heera, Gomed, Cat's Eye. Trikaal Vaani sells no gemstones.

tools.name: numerology
tools.description: Vedic numerology: Mulank (birth number), Bhagyank (destiny number) and Naamank (name number, Chaldean) with ruling planet, lucky colour, day and friendly numbers. Needs only date of birth (and optional name).

tools.name: lucky_day
tools.description: Luckiest day, colour, number, metal and direction from the strongest planet (Shadbala), and which weekdays are lucky, neutral or challenging for this chart.

tools.name: baby_name_by_nakshatra
tools.description: Lucky starting syllable (naamakshar) from the baby's Moon nakshatra and pada, with name suggestions and meanings.

tools.name: kundali_strength
tools.description: Overall birth-chart strength score (average Shadbala against classical minimum across the 7 grahas), grade, how many planets are strong, and the planet ranking.

tools.name: weak_planet
tools.description: The weakest graha by Shadbala, the life areas it affects, and its strength numbers — the planet that most needs support.

tools.name: lagna_bal
tools.description: Ascendant (lagna) lord: its house, strength and Shadbala ratio with a Strong/Moderate/Weak label, the meaning of the house it sits in, and the planets in the 1st house.

tools.name: life_reading
tools.description: Granth-based reading for a life question, written from classical texts (BPHS, Phaladeepika) — no AI writing: ex coming back, toxic boss / job change, career pivot, property purchase timing, child's destiny, spiritual purpose, wealth, compatibility, or a general kundali reading. Free view; the full R

tools.name: panchang_today
tools.description: Daily Hindu Panchang for a date (default today, India): tithi, nakshatra, yoga, karana, vaar, sunrise/sunset and muhurat windows.

tools.name: vivah_muhurat
tools.description: Strict-classical shubh marriage dates for a year with muhurat time, nakshatra, tithi and lagna. Excludes Kharmas, Adhik Maas and Chaturmas. Not personalised to any birth chart.

tools.name: full_report_options
tools.description: Lists Trikaal Vaani's paid reports with prices (India Rs / international USD) and where to buy: Deep Reading, Yog reports, Kundali Milan, Muhurat report, Karmic Background Reading, AI Hast Rekha (palm photo), Swapna Shastra (dream reading), Trikaal Voice, and personal consultation with Rohiit Gupta.
